title: MCP Server JSON-RPC Dispatch
signature: class McpServer: __init__(self, server_info, tools), handle(self, raw) -> Optional[str]
hints: Work in layers: parse the text, then split a batch, then validate the envelope, then decide request vs notification, then dispatch on the method.
A notification is a valid message with no "id" key. It never gets a response, not even an error, and here it never runs a tool.

Two kinds of failure: protocol errors (bad envelope, unknown method, unknown tool, missing arguments) go in "error", and a tool that raises goes in "result" with isError: true, so the model can read the failure.
A batch whose elements are all notifications returns None, not "[]". An empty batch [] is a single Invalid Request object.
